notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
We are very happy to announce that our wonderful  VR game "Wings of Legends" has a new release available on Steam VR - a content update which includes a new game mode and new levels!

This update includes many improvements to the game, including a new maps, system for making points, awesome Music and SFX. 
⠀
You can move more naturally along with many improvements to the game. You will have to earn a rating and break huge mystical spheres that will fly at you and try to knock you out of the saddle. So keep your balance and look around! Put on your virtual reality glasses, and you will find yourself in an incredible new world where danger will come at every step, but a dynamic scenario and cool music will make you feel like a very cool hero of some fantastic blockbuster!

Restart steam if you don't see the update, GLHF :) 
To celebrate, Budget Cuts is 15% off for a limited time! 

Check it out!
